questions.statement: Which word names the piece of furniture where you sit and watch television?
questions.context: Clase de ingles de tercer grado en la que los estudiantes identifican los muebles de una casa dibujada.

options.feedback: The sofa is the three or four seat piece of furniture where a family sits to watch television.
The bed is for sleeping and not for sitting in front of the television.
The wardrobe stores clothes and is not used as a seat.
The fridge keeps food cold and is not a piece of furniture where you sit.

questions.explanation: Los muebles de la sala se distinguen por su funcion: sofa para sentarse, armchair para una sola persona y coffee table para apoyar objetos. Cuando el enunciado describe una accion, como ver television, se elige el mueble disenado para ella.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Complete the sentence with the best word: "I sleep in my ___. It is next to the window."
questions.context: Ejercicio de descripcion de la habitacion donde duerme el estudiante.

options.feedback: The kitchen is a space of the house, but it is not a piece of furniture where someone sleeps.
bed is the correct word in English, and the sentence says that one sleeps in that piece of furniture.
The mirror hangs on the wall and has no function of rest.
The garden is an outdoor area of the house, not a piece of furniture in the bedroom.

questions.explanation: Repasando el vocabulario de la casa conviene separar espacios de casa como kitchen y garden de muebles como bed y wardrobe. El enunciado pide un mueble, y esa distincion de categoria descarta las dos opciones que nombran lugares.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "There is a small table in the kitchen and a big table in the dining room." How many tables are there?
questions.context: Lectura de un texto sobre la casa de la familia de un estudiante.

options.feedback: One would be the answer if the text mentioned a single table.
The text names two different tables, one in the kitchen and another in the dining room.
Three would require a third table that the text does not mention.
Four goes beyond what the sentence lists, which is limited to two tables.

questions.explanation: Contar objetos que aparecen en dos lugares distintos es una comprension numerica basica. La estrategia es identificar cada mencion y anotarla antes de totalizar, porque en los textos cortos es facil perder de vista el segundo elemento.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which sentence uses the correct verb with the plural subject 'the shelves'?
questions.context: Actividad de escritura de una lista de los muebles de un salon.

options.text: There is two armchairs in the living room.
options.feedback: With two armchairs the verb must be are, because the subject two armchairs is plural.

options.text: The wardrobe are next to the door.
options.feedback: The subject the wardrobe is singular and therefore takes the verb is.

options.text: The shelves are above the TV.
options.feedback: The subject the shelves is plural and therefore agrees with are.

options.text: A lamp are on the table.
options.feedback: With the singular subject a lamp the verb has to be is and not are.

questions.explanation: La concordancia entre sujeto y verbo se comprueba mirando si el sustantivo lleva articulo plural o numeral mayor que uno. Las tres opciones incorrectas fallan en ese mismo punto, por lo que un solo ejercicio de revision de la concordancia resuelve toda la pregunta.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which word names the piece of furniture where clothes hang?
questions.context: Ejercicio de ubicacion de muebles en una habitacion a partir de un plano.

options.feedback: The bookshelf stores books and not hanging clothes.
The wardrobe has a rail where the clothes hang and it is the piece of furniture the sentence asks for.
The nightstand holds small objects such as a lamp or a glass.
The oven is a kitchen appliance and does not store clothes.

questions.explanation: Cada mueble de la casa tiene un contenido caracteristico: el armario recibe ropa, el estante recibe libros y la nevera recibe alimentos. Esta association mueble y contenido es la que permite responder preguntas de vocabulario de la casa con rapidez.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Complete the dialogue: "Where is the remote control?" "It is ___ the sofa."
questions.context: Ejercicio de conversacion en casa entre madre e hija.

options.feedback: on describes an object resting on the surface of another, like the remote on the sofa.
in would indicate the remote is inside the sofa, which is impossible because it is a solid piece of furniture.
under would mean the remote is below the furniture and the question does not indicate that position.
between requires two objects flanking the remote, and here only the sofa is mentioned.

questions.explanation: En una habitacion los objetos pequeños suelen aparecer en las superficies horizontales, y por eso se localizan con on. La combinacion mas frecuente en dialogos domésticos es on the table, on the sofa y on the shelf.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "The house has three bedrooms, one kitchen and two bathrooms." How many rooms does the house have in total?
questions.context: Lectura de un texto publicitario sobre la venta de una casa.

options.feedback: Five would be the result of adding only the bedrooms and the kitchens, without the bathrooms.
3 + 1 + 2 = 6, and the three categories in the advert add up to exactly six spaces.
Four counts the categories of room, not the total number of spaces.
Seven would require an extra piece of information that the advert does not include.

questions.explanation: El anuncio proves numeros en tres categorias distintas, y sumarlos es un ejercicio de comprension numerica en contexto. La respuesta debe mostrar la operacion para que el estudiante compruebe que no omitio ninguna de las categorias enumeradas.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which group contains only furniture from a house?
questions.context: Actividad final en la que los estudiantes dibujan las partes de una casa y las rotulan.

options.feedback: Those three words name spaces of the house, not pieces of furniture.
The television is an appliance and not a piece of furniture, so the group is not correct.
The three are pieces of furniture used to store or support objects inside a home.
The car does not belong inside a house and breaks the classification.

questions.explanation: Distinguir espacios, muebles y electrodomésticos es una clasificacion basica que aparece en las pruebas. Los muebles sostienen o guardan objetos, mientras que un televisor o una lampara funcionan por si mismos, y esa funcion los separa del resto.
questions.subject: ingles
